components.name: Service Row
components.description: Open, ruled photographic path to a service page, retaining the original full description.
components.html:
Chantier de terrassement

Préparation de terrain et travaux de terrassement.

↗
components.css: .ds-service-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: .75fr .8fr 1.1fr 32px; align-items: center; gap: 32px; padding: 36px 0; border-top: 1px solid #cbd2c7; color: #24392d; } .ds-service-row img { width: 100%; height: auto; aspect-ratio: 4/5; object-fit: cover; } .ds-service-title { font: 700 clamp(27px, 2.7vw, 39px)/1.06 "Barlow Semi Condensed", "Arial Narrow", Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-service-description { color: #586557; font: 400 16px/1.65 Barlow, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-service-title:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6b7600; outline-offset: 5px; } @media(max-width:520px) { .ds-service-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr 32px; gap:22px 16px; padding:29px 0; } .ds-service-row img,.ds-service-description { grid-column:1/-1; } .ds-service-row img { aspect-ratio:16/9; } }

narrative.overview:
Pro-Ter-Pa presents outdoor work as a photographic landscape journal, preserving its original facing-page composition, woodland green, chalk paper and chartreuse. Self-hosted Barlow typography and real photographs make the open service rows scannable without replacing their full descriptions.

Category filters, stable photo links and truthful sharing feedback help visitors explore the work. On mobile, a reserved-space contact bar provides direct actions without competing with navigation or the native-dialog viewer. Preserve the complete photo archive, business information and distinct original-site/V2 legal contexts.
keyCharacteristics: Self-hosted Barlow and Barlow Semi Condensed typography.
Real landscape and chantier photography as the primary visual proof.
Open rows, calm paper surfaces, and restrained green/chartreuse accents.
Clear service routes and direct telephone and email contact.

rules.name: The Real-Work Rule
rules.body: Let the photographs carry the variety of the landscape; keep the interface palette to the established greens, chalk, sage, and chartreuse.

rules.name: The Practical Contrast Rule
rules.body: Keep display hierarchy bold and compact; supporting prose remains relaxed and readable rather than adopting the heading face.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Use tonal fields, borders, and photography—not decorative card shadows—to distinguish content.

dos: Do use real Pro-Ter-Pa photographs as the leading visual evidence.
Do maintain the chalk-paper, woodland-green, soft-sage, and chartreuse palette.
Do leave service paths open and scannable, with thin rules rather than cards.
Do keep telephone and email links pointed to the shipped direct-contact destinations.
Do preserve the existing footer, photo archive, and contact/legal distinctions.
donts: Don't replace the monograph direction with a generic contractor template or decorative stock imagery.
Don't invent pricing, testimonials, services, or claims.
Don't add rounded cards, decorative shadows, or a fake contact form.
Don't remove the original photo archive or collapse the distinct contact and legal contexts.
